_about: Stage 1 lines. One entry per on-screen line. Japanese: '|' marks the only places a vertical column may break (removed on screen). English: りりー's corrected lines (P0.2). opening = lines shown in this order before the intro bell (later, insert e1a or e1b between s1_line_01 and s1_line_02). autoBellDelaySec = wait this many seconds after the last opening line's subtitle (and voice, if any) has finished, then Tatsuo rings by himself. s1_line_03 follows that bell (trigger first_bell). If the player rings earlier, s1_line_03 waits until the opening list is finished.

lines.ja: 目を開けているのか、|閉じているのかすら|判らない。
lines.en: I can't even tell whether my eyes are open or closed.

lines.ja: からりと音が跳ね、|四方の壁が|わずかに|息を吹き返す。
lines.en: The chime skips into the dark, and the walls around me faintly breathe back to life.

lines.ja: 隙間から、|冷たく淀んだ|廊下の空気が|滑り込んできた。
lines.en: Cold, stale air from the hallway creeps in through the gap.
